title: The Spark is back

slides.title: The Spark comes back
slides.text: All four pieces are home. You put them together, and the Spark flares up. All over Netville the games hum back to life.

slides.title: Bolt says thanks
slides.text: Bolt spins his antenna. You taught my roads to run again, he says. Every loop and every careful turn — that was you.

slides.title: Dot, Pim and Gizmo
slides.text: Dot's tail is wagging, Pim's wings are wide, and Gizmo is bouncing too high to sit still. Four pieces, four worlds, one coder: you.

slides.title: Look what you can do
slides.text: Look how far you have come. You can write steps in order and use loops to repeat them. You can make decisions with if and else, fix bugs, and send packets across a network.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four big words that are yours now.

words.means: a list of steps, in order, that solves a problem
a small piece of a message, sent across a network
what goes into a computer: a tap, a key, a sound
to find and fix a mistake in your code

slides.title: You are a coder now
slides.text: The Spark was never magic. It runs on code, and code is written by people who learned, one step at a time. Now you are one of them.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: One thing is left. In Netville, coders do not just play games — they build them. Your building tools are ready. What will you make?

talk: If you could build any game for Netville, what would it be about?
